arStrings.szText: Select an {c_highlight}Infernal Offer{/c} to invoke {c_highlight}Boons{/c} and {c_highlight}Banes{/c} shaping your path through the coming waves.
Invoking {c:FF9b5483}Chaos Waves{/c} will create a challenging encounter, offering no boons or banes, only greater {c_highlight}Aether{/c} rewards.
Open your map to view your current {c_highlight}Boons{/c} and {c_highlight}Banes{/c}.
Endure the waves to summon the {c_highlight}Fell Council{/c}, or prove yourself worthy, and face {c:FF9b5483}Bartuc, Warlord of Chaos{/c}.
